aggregation: mean measured elevation within each display cell
coverage_policy: same cells at every date; at least 99.5% measured coverage in each survey

projection.method: Per-display-cell ordinary least squares elevation trend over 2015, 2022, 2024, anchored to observed 2024 elevation
projection.semantics: Exploratory historical-trend extrapolation; not a validated geomorphology forecast
projection.drivers: Only historical elevations; no future rainfall, development, interventions, sediment transport or episodic events
projection.uncertainty: No validated confidence interval. Geoid/survey offsets and historical disturbances may be extrapolated as apparent change.

risk.meaning: Relative uncalibrated susceptibility to observed terrain lowering
risk.source: Verified final GeoRisk raster display export; not a synthetic or re-trained score
risk.sampled_scores: Approximate bins recovered from the original 256-color display PNG; not exact 1 m queries
